meta.name: sponsored-newsletter-finder
meta.description: Discover newsletters in a target niche relevant to your ICP, evaluate audience fit, estimate reach and CPM, and output a ranked shortlist of sponsorship opportunities. Uses web search to find newsletters, then scores each against ICP alignment criteria. Use when a marketing team wants to reach an existing engaged audience for less than the cost of building their own, or when testing a new channel before committing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现目标受众的赞助机会并评估投放效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们想通过赞助邮件通讯触达精准受众
copy.tagline_en: Discover sponsorship opportunities in target niches and evaluate audience fit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to reach engaged audiences via newsletter sponsorships

howto.what: Claude 会搜索目标受众常读的新闻邮件，评估其受众匹配度、订阅量、打开率等，并输出一份按优先级排序的赞助机会清单，包含预算分配建议和联系模板。
howto.when: 当你说出“找我能赞助的新闻邮件”或“我的目标受众读哪些新闻邮件”等类似请求时触发。

say.text: 找我能赞助的新闻邮件，目标受众是B2B SaaS公司的销售副总裁。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集ICP定义、预算等信息。

say.text: 我的目标受众是产品经理，帮我找适合赞助的新闻邮件。
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关新闻邮件并评分。

say.text: 我想测试新闻邮件赞助渠道，预算每月2000美元。
say.note: Claude 会输出排名清单和预算分配建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will search for newsletters your target audience reads, evaluate audience fit, subscriber count, open rate, etc., and output a ranked shortlist of sponsorship opportunities with budget allocation recommendations and outreach templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "Find newsletters I can sponsor to reach [ICP]" or "What newsletters does my target audience read?".

say_en.text: Find newsletters I can sponsor to reach VPs of Sales at B2B SaaS companies.
say_en.note: Claude will start intake for ICP definition and budget.

say_en.text: What newsletters do product managers read? I want sponsorship ideas.
say_en.note: Claude will search and score newsletters.

say_en.text: I want to test newsletter sponsorship with a $2000 monthly budget.
say_en.note: Claude will output a ranked shortlist and budget allocation.
